names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Πρόκλος, Απολλώνιος και Εφήβιος», with the rank word left off; the life page heads him «Αγιος Εφήβιος» alone.

death.note: They were taken while burying the relic of `valentine-of-rome` and martyred at Rome, which is the whole of what the saint.gr page this folder cites says of the three; that folder records his death as the reign its own page prints, 41 to 54, and theirs follows his within it.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Πρόκλος, Απολλώνιος και Εφήβιος»

attestations.note: One page for the three of them, which says only that they were taken when they went to bury the relic of the hieromartyr Valentine, kept on the same day, and were martyred at Rome. It prints no year and no hymn.
